definition: The task of automatically generating a natural language description of the contents of an image.
details: Image captioning combines visual understanding with language generation, and is a classic benchmark task for evaluating multimodal models that must connect visual and textual representations.
story: Picture walking through a crowd and instantly picking out a familiar face without reading a single name tag. Here is the short version: The task of automatically generating a natural language description of the contents of an image. The part that makes it sing: Image captioning combines visual understanding with language generation, and is a classic benchmark task for evaluating multimodal models that must connect visual and textual representations. Sight, for a machine, is a long climb from raw light to a name. And that is Image Captioning — giving a machine the gift of sight.
